findings.title: Metric alert handler is now abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: `StatefulDetectorHandler` has abstract methods for `counter_names`, dedupe extraction, group-key extraction, and occurrence construction, but this subclass implements none of them. Since this handler is registered on `MetricAlertFire`, accessing `detector.detector_handler` for a metric-alert detector attempts to instantiate it and raises `TypeError` rather than returning a handler. Implement the required hooks or keep this registered handler concrete.
